about: Docs/Design/84 §15.3: the talk scorecard (tools/talk_score.py), from talk_sim transcripts.

R4.name: distinctive line heard again within 10 h, per 100 h

R7.name: distinct reply entries per 1,000 reply beats

R8.name: habit saturation (% of a speaker's lines, mean)

C1Q.name: questions answered: the '?' heuristic (%)
C1Q.target: diagnostic (C1 until Phase 3; doesn't separate from the control)

C2.name: replies at the best fit available (%)

C3.name: endings by a farewell or a marked break (%)

C6.name: same entry or question twice in a conversation, per 1,000

T3.name: self-reference errors (own name, the listener in the third person, unbacked eyewitness words), per 1,000 lines

T4.name: identity drift: a stance changed with no event or concede, or answered against one's own, per 1,000 stance lines

T6.name: 'they' said of one known wolf named in the line, per 1,000 lines

D1A.name: lines said a step broader or plainer than the speaker's own accent (%)

T5.name: telling what the listener already believes, with no 'known' answer (%)

D1.name: lines with a dialect's words (%): accent none

D1L.name: lines with a dialect's words (%): light speakers

D1B.name: lines with a dialect's words (%): broad speakers

D2.name: another dialect's words in a speaker's line

D3.name: dialect guessed from 20 lines (%): light and broad

U1.name: a resident's lines from their own words (%)

K3.name: same news told twice to the same resident

W3.name: a resident answers chat with the option off

X1.name: lexical cohesion: replies sharing a content word with the line before (%)
X1.target: diagnostic (not in §15.3): shows the control is discriminating

examples: rmx_magda_orme: Good evening. A cutpurse took Rupert Fogton's things. They'll be disappointed.
rmx_ulla_brindle: Hello. Another bad business. It never stops. A thief took Wenna Tarford's things. They'll be disappointed.
rm_edmund_sootdale: Back again? Somebody robbed Josephine Fenwick. I hope they wiped their paws.
rm_rosamund_tarridge: Hello. Take the warm end. We'd only just finished with the last of this. Another theft. Desmond Bilgeridge. They should make an example.
And it's not the first this week. They say Orla Wickby was robbed on the long stair. / rmx_philippa_coldby: If they'd taken a ledger from the Hall of Records I'd understand. Coin? Vulgar.
Back again? They cleaned out Rosamund Tarridge. Down to the spoons. / rm_torvald_slagton: Spoons. Gods. Were they silver?
Can't keep away, then. Orla Wickby! In broad day! And the watch drinking somewhere! / rm_elspet_sootley: Will they come to our house?
In a city this size, and still everyone knows. Florence Pennock is wanted by the Watch for attempted theft. / rmx_montague_kettlewick: Good luck to them catching her.
That's not the only tale going. Corwin Bilgestack tried to steal from Finn Dripwick. I'd never have thought it. / Bright One! Is that so?
And another thing. Right, you. Listen. Rupert Greyley is wanted by the Watch for attempted theft. / Huh. Typical.
Your cousin should mind his tongue. / He never has.
A little bird. / Work won't wait.
morning_greeting: Morning to you; the loaves are honest. In my day you could leave a door open. Now Jorunn Saltdale tried to steal from Theodora Ropemarsh. (rm_dagny_slaghand, indoors/clear 20h)
own_name: rm_magda_rustham to rmx_cressida_mallory: Magda Rustham. And I'll confess I've lost yours too.
rmx_grete_dunn: A light-pawed sort took Dagny Slaghand's things. Hope they like them.
rm_osric_slagstack: The little ones keep asking about Arne Wickdale. What do I tell them?
Good evening. They'll blame the Sump for Rosamund Tarridge. Watch. / rmx_edda_muddale: I can't say I blame them. Don't look at me like that.
While we're on folk behaving badly. Somebody got Rosamund Tarridge. Not me, before you ask. / rmx_ebba_netherby: Why did they do it?
My neighbour nailed their shutters shut after Finn Dripwick. / cty_hob_appleby: And how do they get the air in?
A light-pawed sort took Dagny Slaghand's things. Hope they like them. / rm_aldric_grayrock_: They'll have a fine time with the old chair.
Soren Ashcote is wanted by the Watch for attempted theft. The whole town knows it now. / rm_eleanor_wetby: Good luck to them catching him.
Rika Gullwell is wanted by the Watch for attempted theft. Best not be seen with her. / rmx_tobias_dunley: I hope they find her, then.
There's more, mind. Bar the door tonight. Pell Plumgarth tried to steal from Ebba Heath. / Since when?
That's not the only tale going. You'll like this one. Rika Gullwell tried to steal from Dagny Slaghand. / Rika Gullwell? I'd want that from someone who saw it.
There's more, mind. Quietly. Frida Rainhand tried to steal from Edric Millton. / Well, strike me.
Sadly, yes. / Then I'm staying.
That's what I heard: the Rainward Hills. / This won't earn my keep.
children: And that's not the only wagon. My son rides with the Southmeadow caravan. (tn_lf_tansy_sunmead, indoors/clear 9h)
Vale Miremore burnt the bread again. Don't tell anyone. / tn_oh_quill_oakdell: Give them my best.
children: Hello. In you come. We were talking wagons lately, too. My son rides with the Coldwater caravan. (rm_rosamund_tarridge, indoors/clear 17h)
rmx_ivar_netherworth: Back again? A cutpurse took from Wenna Tarford. Bet they ate well tonight.
Hello, friend. We'd only just finished with the last of this. My neighbour nailed their shutters shut after Wenna Tarford. / rm_winifred_cinderworth: And how do they get the air in?
Hello. Somebody lifted Wenna Tarford's coin on the way home. / rmx_maren_hatherley: When I was young we hanged thieves at the gate. Not that it stopped them.
Good day. A thief by the Rain Hall. Wynn Rustworth, robbed under the Council's own windows. / rmx_lothar_abbot: If they'd taken a ledger from the Hall of Records I'd understand. Coin? Vulgar.

Good day, neighbour. We'd only just finished with the last of this. The Watch is turning out every street in the Commons over Josephine Fenwick. / rmx_lothar_abbot: If they'd taken a ledger from the Hall of Records I'd understand. Coin? Vulgar.
Good day. Now it's Bo Gilbey. The road wolves have come into town. / rm_wenna_tarford: Or one of ours, using them as cover.
That's not the only tale going. Brenna Milldale stole from Rupert Fogton, according to everyone. / That wants saying to her face.
Not lately, no. / Thank you. I'll wait.
Our orders are the city. / Lucky city.

control.how: talk_sim --ablate shuffle: lines after the first replaced by lines said at the same side of other conversations on the same topic, by a speaker of the same dialect where possible (§15.5)
